name: darrow-adaptive-goal
description: Adaptive Goal: diagnose host capacity or coordinate bounded engineering with a main-thread native goal

interface.shortDescription: A native goal with direct or delegated implementation and separate verification
interface.longDescription: Keep acceptance, user decisions and completion in the main thread. Implement directly, or delegate routed implementation when the route requires it or cost or concurrency repays the handoff, and delegate selected verification using native goal continuation.
defaultPrompt: Diagnose host capacity or coordinate this bounded request with a main-thread native goal.
